orgId.description: The unique identifier of the organization to which the summarized interactions belong.

agentCiUserId.description: The CI (Common Identity) user ID of the agent associated with the summaries. Present when searchType is AGENT; otherwise null.

interactionId.description: The unique identifier of a specific interaction. Present when searchType is INTERACTION; otherwise null.

queueId.description: The queue ID (reserved for future use).

summaries.description: Map of summaries keyed by feature type (POST_CALL, MID_CALL). Each feature maps summary identifiers to their summary fields.

POST_CALL.description: Post-call summaries keyed by summary identifier.

MID_CALL.description: Mid-call summaries keyed by summary identifier.

reasonForTransferOrConsult.description: The specific reason the interaction is being transferred or consulted.

additionalContext.description: Important information already gathered that the next agent needs to continue smoothly.

keyActionsTaken.description: Steps completed so far in the interaction before the transfer or consult occurred.

initialContactReason.description: The primary issue or request the customer contacted you about at the start of the interaction.

additionalContext.description: Relevant background details shared during the conversation that help explain the situation.

additionalContactReasons.description: Any new or secondary issues raised after the initial reason for contact.

keyActionsTaken.description: The main steps the agent took to investigate, resolve, or address the customer's request.

nextSteps.description: Clear follow-up actions and expected outcomes agreed upon before ending the interaction.

chosenWrapUpCode.description: The wrap-up reason code that was ultimately selected by the agent at the end of the interaction.

proposedWrapUpCodes.description: A list of wrap-up reasons suggested by the AI based on the interaction content. Each object contains a name field. Can return null, 1, or 2 objects.

name.description: The name of the proposed wrap-up reason.

SearchType.description: The type of search to be performed.
